notes.title: 1st Balance update and bug fixes
notes.notes:
Hi, after almost a week after launch it is time to check out balance of relics, cards and combat.

Summary:Combat changes:
Enemy Camp, Swamp Tower, Ancient Mine and Mountain Village got harder.
Forest Castle, Snow Stronghold, River Castle got easier.
Relic changes:
Sapling of Life & Unexpected Goods - got buffed
Card changes:
Furnace & Alchemist - nerfed
Camp, Theater, House Builder, Shelter, Wagon Builder - buffed

StatsCombat changes:
Enemy Camp - Fight 1 - Main structure cost 7 -> 9

Enemy Camp - Fight 2 - Main structure cost 18 -> 21

Swamp Tower - Fight 2 - Starting towers 3 -> 4

Swamp Tower - Fight 2 - Main structure cost 14 -> 16

Swamp Tower - Fight 3 - Starting towers 4 -> 5

Swamp Tower - Fight 3 - Main structure cost 28 -> 32

Mountain Village - Fight 3 - Additional Tower cots 2 -> 3

Mountain Village - Fight 3 - Main structure cost 34 -> 38

Forest Castle - Fight 4 - Building towers increases after 4 turns -> 5 turns

Forest Castle - Fight 4 - Starting towers 4 -> 3

Snow Stronghold - Fight 5 - Starting towers 3 -> 0

Snow Stronghold - Fight 5 - Building towers increases after 4 turns -> 5 turns

Snow Stronghold - Fight 6 - Starting towers 4 -> 1

Snow Stronghold - Fight 6 - Building towers increases after 3 turns -> 5 turns

Snow Stronghold - Fight 6 - Additional Tower cots 5 -> 4

River Castle - Fight 5 - Main structure cost 72-> 67

River Castle - Fight 6 - Main structure cost 100-> 92

Ancient Mine - Fight 6 - Starting towers 4 -> 6

Ancient Mine - Fight 6 - Building towers increases after 3 turns -> 2 turns


Relic changes:
Sapling of Life - When you place a structure size 4 or bigger create forest space in an adjacent space -> When you place a structure size 4 or bigger reduce random enemy defense by 1 Energy

Unexpected Goods - You can buy resources for the reserve in the market -> You can buy resources for the reserve in the market. Add 1 wood to reserve each time you visit market


Card changes:
Furnace - Gem cost 0 -> 1

Alchemist - Gem cost 1 -> 2

Camp - At the end of turn pay 1 day to destroy enemy tower -> At the end of turn pay 1 day to destroy 2 enemy towers

Theater - When you place a building that is touching 4 or more other buildings draw a card -> When you place a building that is touching 3 or more other buildings draw a card.

House Builder - Produces 1 additional lumber

Shelter - Produces 1 additional wood

Wagon Builder - Get 1 additional lumber if places next to enough empty spaces


Bug fixes and improvements:
Enemy indicator now pulsates correctly

Additional info when hovering on enemy towers

Wording changes

You can check deck and relics at the end of combat, when picking rewards

Achievements changes

Game no longer freezes when Lookout Tower destroys more than 5 towers
